episodeTitle.en: Marketplace lessons from Uber, Airbnb, Bumble, and more | Ramesh Johari (Stanford professor)
episodeTitle.zh: 优步、Airbnb、Bumble等平台的市场经验 | 拉梅什·乔哈里（斯坦福大学教授）

guestBioOfficial.en: Ramesh Johari is a professor at Stanford University focusing on data science methods and practice, as well as the design and operation of online markets and platforms. Beyond academia, Ramesh has advised some incredible startups, including Airbnb, Uber, Bumble, and Stitch Fix. Today we discuss: • What exactly a marketplace is, if you boil it down
guestBioOfficial.zh: 拉梅什·乔哈里是斯坦福大学教授，专注于数据科学方法与实践，以及在线市场和平台的设计与运营。除学术领域外，拉梅什还为Airbnb、Uber、Bumble和Stitch Fix等知名初创公司提供咨询服务。今天我们讨论：• 若将市场简化至本质，它究竟是什么？

title.en: Marketplace lessons from Uber, Airbnb, Bumble, and more | Ramesh Johari (Stanford professor)
title.zh: 优步、Airbnb、Bumble等平台的市场经验 | 拉梅什·乔哈里（斯坦福大学教授）

summary.en: Ramesh reframes marketplace businesses around the goal of achieving 'scaled liquidity' on both sides of the platform, and warns that most perceived problems are not marketplace-specific at all. He explains how data science should shift from machine learning to causal inference to truly improve matching and ranking, and why a culture of fast, learning-oriented experiments beats waiting for statistical significance. The conversation is a deep, nerdy dive into building thriving marketplaces.
summary.zh: Ramesh 将市场业务重新定义为追求平台双边“规模化流动性（scaled liquidity）”的目标，并提醒说，大多数看似的问题根本不是市场特有的。他解释了数据科学应当从机器学习转向因果推断，才能真正改善匹配与排序，以及为什么“快速、以学习为导向的实验文化”优于苦等统计显著性。本期是对打造繁荣市场平台的深度、硬核剖析。
